domain_label: Higgsfield Prompting & Model Ops — Photoreal Image Prompt Craft (Anti-Plastic Playbook)
purpose: A method for the units of expert work in writing photoreal image prompts and routing them onto the Higgsfield MCP surface: the Subject+Action+Context+Style anatomy with the 'A photo of' photographic trigger, FLUX.2 word-order weighting and the 30-80 word ideal band, the official Imagen focal-length/film use-case mapping (portraits 24-35mm prime, objects 60-105mm macro, motion telephoto, landscape wide), the anti-plastic playbook (visible pores, fine lines, uneven tone, directional side light not ring light, real optics like 85mm f/1.8-2.8, named film stocks, subtle grain, 3-5 named palette colors), the trigger lexicon that CAUSES the retouched CG look (flawless, perfect skin, stacked hype tokens), negative-prompt practice where supported, Soul/Element character and style referencing, and the one-axis iteration loop — every model id, parameter and constraint quoted only from the live-surface enumeration, never from memory.
assumptions: no generation trials were run; all scores are heuristic priors and no engagement statistic, platform policy or study result is asserted beyond what the two grounding research files carry with their own tags

every Higgsfield model id, parameter, aspect-ratio set, media role and constraint quoted here comes from the read-only live MCP enumeration of 2026-07-03 (higgsfield_surface.md); nothing about the platform is invented or recalled from memory

several official vendor prompt guides (FLUX/BFL, Midjourney, Kling, Seedream/BytePlus, Runway) were 403-blocked to direct fetch this session; their content is carried via search excerpts quoting the official pages and is treated one notch below fully-fetched fact — re-verify exact wording from an unblocked network before hard-coding

the worked luxury-genre prompts are authored craft applying the sourced patterns, explicitly labeled [ESTIMATE]; they are templates to iterate from, not sourced claims of output quality
exclusions: video prompting craft (motion phrasing, image-to-video, start/end-frame interpolation, timestamped multi-shot) — that is the sibling video KB's surface; this KB stops at the still frame
music, speech and audio generation, and all credit-spending generation trials

glossary.definition: The converged image-prompt skeleton: Imagen officially teaches Subject + Context/background + Style; FLUX.2 teaches Subject + Action + Style + Context; Seedream 4.x teaches Subject + Action/Pose + Environment + Style + Technical Details. All vendors put the subject first [FACT - fetched Imagen-guide mirror; FLUX and Seedream official content via search excerpt, direct fetch blocked].

Imagen's official device for photographic (rather than illustrated) style: start the prompt with 'A photo of...'; pair with photo-specific quality modifiers like '4K, HDR, Studio Photo' [FACT - fetched mirror of the official Imagen guide].

FLUX.2's documented behavior that words earlier in the prompt get more attention; the official priority order is main subject, key action, critical style, essential context, then secondary details, so must-have elements are front-loaded [FACT - official docs.bfl.ai content via search excerpt; direct fetch blocked].

The over-smooth, retouched-CG default of generated skin. Cause per concordant practitioner guides: models are trained on heavily retouched, beauty-filtered photos, so airbrushed skin is the learned mode; real skin has pores, fine lines and color shifts that scatter light unevenly — exactly what the default erases [FACT - concordant practitioner guides].

The positive-wording fix set: demand natural skin texture with visible pores, subtle fine lines, realistic uneven skin tone and slight natural shine; name imperfections (freckles, color variation, minor blemishes); specify real optics (85mm lens, f/1.8, natural window light); prefer directional side light over flat ring light; add subtle film grain; name 3-5 palette colors [FACT - practitioner guides + fetched Sora cookbook for the palette rule].

Piles like 'ultra-realistic, 8K, masterpiece, hyperdetailed, trending' — on modern natural-language models (FLUX.2, Imagen 4, Seedream 4) they add little and can drag toward CG-render aesthetics; legacy SD-class models did respond to them, so the effect is model-class dependent [ESTIMATE - practitioner consensus, medium-high confidence].

Higgsfield's trained-identity handle: a Soul character is trained from 5-20 reference images in about 10 minutes and is usable only with the soul_2 and soul_cinematic image models, with exactly ONE soul_id per generation [FACT - live MCP surface 2026-07-03].

Higgsfield's instant reusable reference (category character, environment or prop): created without training and embedded by writing the element id wrapped in triple angle brackets inside the prompt text; multiple element ids per prompt are allowed, making Elements the surface-designated path for two-persona shots; Elements are NOT usable with the Soul models [FACT - live MCP surface 2026-07-03].

Midjourney V7 --oref image reference with --ow 0-1000 (default 100): 25-100 loose influence, 200-400 balanced (most used), 600-1000 near-copy of face/object/style; costs double GPU and is incompatible with Vary Region/Pan/Zoom; combine --oref (identity) with --sref (aesthetic) [FACT - official Midjourney docs and changelog via search excerpt; direct fetch blocked].

The Higgsfield generate_* envelope's sanctioned zero-spend price check: passing get_cost:true returns the credit cost WITHOUT submitting the job; per-model credit costs are not otherwise exposed, so every model-resolution cell must be probed before batching [FACT - live generate_* schemas 2026-07-03; per-model cost table itself UNKNOWN].

nodes.definition: Apply FLUX.2's two documented dials: order and length. 'Word order matters — FLUX.2 pays more attention to what comes first'; the official priority order is main subject, then key action, then critical style, then essential context, then secondary details [FACT - official docs.bfl.ai content via search excerpt; direct fetch blocked]. Length bands: 10-30 words for exploration, 30-80 words 'ideal for most projects', 80+ only for complex scenes [FACT - same source]. The front-loading rule generalizes as an alignment-failure fix on other models: when a must-have element keeps dropping out, move it earlier [ESTIMATE - synthesis, high confidence]. Seedream's parallel band is 30-100 words with subject first [FACT - via search excerpt]. Practical consequence: a luxury portrait draft should land in the 30-80 band with the persona and action in the first clause, and only a locked hero shot earns an 80+ elaboration.

nodes.definition: Lock the color grade by naming 3-5 palette colors in every prompt of a set. The fetched Sora cookbook states that naming 3-5 palette colors stabilizes the grade across shots [FACT - fetched OpenAI cookbook]; the worked luxury prompts apply it as a closing clause ('palette: warm amber, cream, deep navy, slate blue' on the Como portrait; 'ivory, brass, espresso, midnight blue' on the Paris bar; 'charcoal, amber, teal-blue dusk' on the Milan car) [ESTIMATE - authored craft applying the sourced rule]. The palette is chosen once per scene family and reused verbatim across every still in that family, because a re-worded palette is a re-rolled grade; it also gives the negative side a target (oversaturation shows up as palette violation). Palette naming replaces the max-saturation and golden-glow-everywhere asks that the trigger-lexicon node bans.

nodes.definition: Demand real skin explicitly, because the model's default is the retouched mode. Cause: generators are trained on heavily retouched, beauty-filtered photos, so over-smooth skin is the learned default; real skin has pores, fine lines and color shifts that scatter light unevenly — precisely what the default erases [FACT - concordant practitioner guides]. The concordant positive-wording fix: 'natural skin texture with visible pores, subtle fine lines, realistic uneven skin tone, slight natural shine'; demand imperfections (freckles, natural color variation, minor blemishes); specify real-photography optics ('85mm lens', 'f/1.8', 'natural window lighting', side or back light); prefer DIRECTIONAL SIDE LIGHT over flat ring light so micro-shadows read as texture; subtle film grain restores realism [FACT - same concordant guides]. This is the heart of the owner-priority 'it should not look AI': texture words plus directional light are jointly necessary — texture words under flat frontal light still render plastic because there are no micro-shadows to draw.

nodes.definition: Ban the offender lexicon, because these words summon the retouched training mode the texture node fights. Documented offenders: 'flawless skin', 'perfect', 'smooth skin', 'beauty', 'airbrushed' push toward the retouched mode, and flat frontal 'ring light' wording kills texture [FACT - concordant practitioner guides]. Craft-level additions, labeled [ESTIMATE - high confidence]: golden-glow-everywhere ('ethereal glow'), maximum-saturation asks, 'perfect symmetry' for faces, and describing people as 'beautiful/stunning/perfect' instead of physically (age, build, skin, grooming). Each offender has a replacement: 'flawless skin' becomes the visible-pores demand; 'beautiful woman in her 20s' becomes 'a woman in her late 20s, elegant posture, warm medium skin tone with realistic texture'; 'ring light glamour' becomes 'soft tungsten lamp glow from the right, faint cool window light behind her'. The lexicon is enforced as a pre-submit audit: grep the draft for offenders before any generation spends credits.

nodes.definition: Resolve the quality-token question by model class. Stacked hype tokens ('ultra-realistic, 8K, masterpiece, hyperdetailed, trending') on modern natural-language models (FLUX.2, Imagen 4, Seedream 4) add little and can drag toward CG-render aesthetics; the modern replacements are concrete optics, a named film stock and light physics. Legacy SD-class models DID respond to quality-token stacking, so the effect is model-class dependent [ESTIMATE - practitioner consensus, medium-high confidence, carried with that label]. Rule of thumb: if a token names no checkable property of lens, film, light or palette, it is hype; spend the words on the anti-plastic playbook instead.

nodes.definition: Compose the pre-submit go/no-go the whole KB builds toward. A photoreal image prompt is a GO only when: (1) it follows the Subject+Action+Context+Style skeleton with the photographic trigger where the model class wants it; (2) must-have elements are front-loaded and the draft sits in the right length band (30-80 words default); (3) lens/film language matches the Imagen use-case row for the shot type, with a named aperture and film stock; (4) light is specified as source/direction/quality/color with directional side light on any skin; (5) the texture demand is present and the offender lexicon audit is clean (no flawless/perfect-skin/ring-light, no hype stack); (6) 3-5 palette colors are named and verbatim-consistent with the scene family; (7) the model route is confirmed on the live surface with the target aspect ratio present and resolution ceiling requested; (8) identity is wired correctly — one soul_id on Soul models, Element ids only on Element-compatible models, verbatim character block either way; (9) negatives are routed per the model's actual mechanism or converted to positive phrasing where none exists; (10) cost is get_cost-probed and the batch fits count 1-4 with at least 2 samples planned per variant. Any request to evoke a specific real person while hiding or obscuring the face is a NO-GO by exclusion, refused rather than optimized. A prompt failing any item returns to the owning node; nothing ships on vibes.

included: the ten-item pre-submit checklist and its routing back to owning nodes
the closed-lane refusal for masked real-person likeness
the no-ship-on-vibes rule

conflict_axes.name: texture_realism_vs_beauty_polish
conflict_axes.description: The anti-plastic playbook demands pores, fine lines and uneven tone while the luxury genre's instinct is polished beauty language — and the beauty words are exactly the offenders that summon the retouched mode.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state polish physically (grooming, wardrobe, light quality) and never via flawless/perfect/beauty words; the texture demand stays in every skin shot

conflict_axes.name: clause_completeness_vs_word_budget
conflict_axes.description: The full studio anatomy (texture, optics, light, palette, composition) wants more words than the FLUX-documented 30-80 ideal band comfortably holds.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: front-load by priority order and let secondary details drop first; reserve 80+ elaborations for locked hero shots

conflict_axes.name: official_modifiers_vs_hype_stack
conflict_axes.description: Imagen officially documents quality modifiers like '4K, HDR, Studio Photo' while practitioner consensus holds that stacked hype tokens drag modern models toward CG-render aesthetics.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: one or two official modifiers on Imagen-class models only; stacks banned everywhere; concrete optics beat tokens when the word budget is tight

conflict_axes.name: negative_field_vs_positive_only
conflict_axes.description: Some models take dedicated negative inputs (Kling field, Midjourney --no) while FLUX.2 officially takes none, so one exclusion strategy cannot serve the whole catalog.
poles: route exclusions to a negative mechanism
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the routed model's schema decides; keep a pruned negative block ready for models with fields and a positive-conversion habit for those without

conflict_axes.name: trained_soul_fidelity_vs_instant_element_flexibility
conflict_axes.description: Souls cost training time (and unknown credits) for trained identity on exactly two models; Elements are instant and multi-model but their fidelity gap versus Souls is unmeasured.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: run both lanes per persona: Soul for solo heroes on the two Soul models, Element for everything else, and measure the fidelity gap at first trial

conflict_axes.name: single_identity_lock_vs_two_persona_shots
conflict_axes.description: The one-soul_id-per-generation constraint makes the highest-fidelity lane structurally solo, while the genre needs couple shots.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: two-persona shots always go the multi-Element route on an Element-compatible model; never attempt two soul_ids

conflict_axes.name: exploration_breadth_vs_credit_spend
conflict_axes.description: Stochastic sampling demands multiple samples per variant for honest A/B, but per-model credit costs are unknown until probed and the balance is finite.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: probe with get_cost first; minimum attributable design (one axis, two variants, two samples) until the cell is priced

conflict_axes.name: front_loading_vs_natural_prose
conflict_axes.description: FLUX rewards mechanical front-loading while Midjourney and Sora-class guidance favors coherent prose and warns against list-like prompts.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: write prose whose FIRST sentence carries the must-haves — front-loaded order inside natural sentences serves both masters

conflict_axes.name: template_literalism_vs_internal_enhancement
conflict_axes.description: The worked templates assume the prompt reaches the model as written, but whether Higgsfield's internal prompt enhancement rewrites prompts first is unknown, which would change how literally the craft transfers.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold the templates as authored hypotheses; run the same template with and without minimal phrasing in the first trial round to detect rewriting

edge_cases.description: A portrait renders plastic despite the texture demand being present
edge_cases.trigger: an offender word (flawless, perfect skin) or flat ring-light phrasing survived into the draft, or the light spec is frontal so no micro-shadow can draw texture
edge_cases.mitigation: run the offender audit, then verify the light is directional side/back light before touching any other axis

edge_cases.description: A negative block is pasted into a FLUX.2-class prompt that officially supports no negative prompts
edge_cases.trigger: the studio default negative block is applied without checking the routed model's mechanism
edge_cases.mitigation: convert each exclusion into positive phrasing of the wanted property and drop the block on FLUX-class routes

edge_cases.description: A 21:9 poster frame is drafted for soul_2, which does not carry 21:9
edge_cases.trigger: the aspect ratio is chosen from the deliverable spec without checking the routed model's ratio set
edge_cases.mitigation: re-route to soul_cinematic, cinematic_studio_2_5, seedream_v4_5 or the Nano Banana set, all of which carry 21:9 per the surface

edge_cases.description: A couple shot is attempted with two soul_ids in one generation
edge_cases.trigger: the two-persona need is forced through the Soul lane, which allows exactly one soul_id per generation
edge_cases.mitigation: switch to the multi-Element route on an Element-compatible model, embedding one element id per persona

edge_cases.description: Element ids are embedded in a soul_2 or soul_cinematic prompt
edge_cases.trigger: the Element and Soul lanes are mixed, though the surface states Elements are not usable with the Soul models
edge_cases.mitigation: keep the lanes exclusive per generation: Soul models take soul_id only, Element models take element ids only

edge_cases.description: A legacy-style hype stack ('8K masterpiece hyperdetailed') is ported onto a modern natural-language model and the render drifts CG
edge_cases.trigger: prompting habit from legacy SD-class models is applied to flux_2 or the Nano Banana set
edge_cases.mitigation: strip the stack and spend the words on optics, film stock and light physics; carry the claim's ESTIMATE label when explaining

edge_cases.description: An A/B conclusion is drawn from one sample per variant under stochastic sampling
edge_cases.trigger: seed-fixed isolation is assumed although seed exposure on the Higgsfield surface is unverified
edge_cases.mitigation: require at least 2 samples per variant and treat seed control as unavailable until a schema read proves otherwise

edge_cases.description: A four-sample batch is submitted with no cost knowledge and burns an unplanned share of the 1,010-credit balance
edge_cases.trigger: the per-model credit cost unknown is ignored and no get_cost probe precedes the batch
edge_cases.mitigation: probe every model-resolution cell with get_cost:true before its first batch; treat uncosted submission as a spec violation

edge_cases.description: An exploration draft balloons past 80 words and adherence drops on the front-loaded must-haves
edge_cases.trigger: clause completeness is pursued during exploration instead of at hero-lock time
edge_cases.mitigation: cut to the 30-80 band keeping the priority order: subject, action, critical style, essential context; park secondary details for the locked version

edge_cases.description: The character block is paraphrased between shots and the persona's features drift across the set
edge_cases.trigger: a shot-level rewrite touches the identity text ('short dark textured hair' becomes 'cropped brown hair')
edge_cases.mitigation: restore the verbatim block from the canonical copy and confine edits to the shot block; version the block explicitly if the persona design truly changed

edge_cases.description: An Element-routed generation may hit the nano-banana id collision (nano_banana_2 labeled 'Nano Banana Pro', nano_banana_flash absent from the catalog)
edge_cases.trigger: an Element prompt is routed by display name instead of surface id while the routing collision is unresolved
edge_cases.mitigation: route by exact surface id, note the collision as a named unknown, and verify the effective model on the first Element trial's job metadata

edge_cases.description: A request asks to evoke a specific real celebrity while keeping the face hidden or obscured
edge_cases.trigger: a masked-likeness ask arrives dressed as a style request
edge_cases.mitigation: refuse per the closed-lane exclusion; offer an original persona built from physical description and the character block instead

workflow.action: Draft the shot on the Subject+Action+Context+Style skeleton
workflow.description: Write prose carrying subject physical specifics, action/pose, environment and style, opening with 'A photo of' for photographic mode on Imagen-class targets
workflow.gate: all anatomy slots present in prose form, photographic trigger placed per model class

workflow.action: Front-load must-haves and fit the length band
workflow.description: Order clauses main subject, key action, critical style, essential context, secondary details; land in 30-80 words for standard work
workflow.gate: must-have elements in the first clause(s); word count in band or justified as locked-hero 80+

workflow.action: Set lens and film language from the Imagen use-case table
workflow.description: Pick the table row matching the shot type (portrait 24-35mm prime, object macro 60-105mm, motion telephoto, landscape wide) and its keywords
workflow.gate: focal range matches the use-case row; no contradictory rows mixed

workflow.action: Specify light as source, direction, quality and color contrast
workflow.description: Name each light source with direction and hard/soft quality plus a warm/cool contrast, Sora-anchor style
workflow.gate: all four light components named; no bare mood adjectives standing in for light

workflow.action: Insert the texture demand and run the offender audit
workflow.description: Add visible pores, subtle fine lines, uneven tone, natural shine and named imperfections on any skin; grep for flawless/perfect/smooth-skin/beauty/airbrushed/ring-light and hype stacks
workflow.gate: texture demand present on skin shots; offender and hype audits clean; side light confirmed

workflow.action: Anchor optics and lock the palette
workflow.description: Fix focal-plus-aperture (portrait default 85mm f/1.8-2.8), name a film stock or sensor with subtle grain, and close with 3-5 named palette colors reused verbatim in the scene family
workflow.gate: aperture present with focal length; stock named; 3-5 colors matching the family palette

workflow.action: Route the shot to a surface-confirmed model, ratio and resolution
workflow.description: Choose by dominant need (identity, edit precision, adherence, resolution ceiling, environment) from the enumerated catalog and confirm the target ratio and ceiling on that model
workflow.gate: model id, params and ratio quoted from the live enumeration; ceiling explicitly requested if needed

workflow.action: Wire identity through the correct lane
workflow.description: Solo hero on soul_2/soul_cinematic with one soul_id; two-persona or non-Soul routes via Element ids on a compatible model; verbatim character and wardrobe blocks either way
workflow.gate: one soul_id max; no Element ids on Soul models; character block verbatim against the canonical copy

workflow.action: Route exclusions per the model's negative mechanism
workflow.description: Attach the pruned negative block where a field exists; convert exclusions to positive phrasing on FLUX-class routes; never write negation sentences in the prompt body
workflow.gate: mechanism matches the routed model's schema; no 'no X' phrasing inside the prompt body

workflow.action: Probe cost and plan the batch inside the envelope
workflow.description: get_cost:true on the exact model-resolution cell, then plan count 1-4 with at least 2 samples per variant, media values as media_id/job_id
workflow.gate: cell probed; batch within count 1-4; no URL media values; spend fits the credit plan

workflow.action: Diagnose failures by class and iterate one axis
workflow.description: Classify each bad render against the taxonomy, change exactly one named axis, re-batch with 2+ samples, and log the change and outcome
workflow.gate: one axis moved per round; class named before the edit; log updated

workflow.action: Run the ten-item go/no-go and promote winners
workflow.description: Check all ten items, refuse closed-lane asks, bounce failures to their owning nodes, and promote winning phrasing into the persona/genre style block
workflow.gate: all ten items pass or the prompt is bounced; closed-lane refusal enforced

priority_rationale: The anatomy, word-order/length, lens-table and light-physics foundations come first because every downstream clause is written into the slots they define; the anti-plastic core (texture demand, offender lexicon, hype discipline, optics anchor, palette lock) follows because it is the owner-priority quality gate applied to those slots; the model-ops nodes (routing, aspect/resolution, Soul, Elements, envelope) then bind the drafted craft to the only platform surface that can execute it, quoting the 2026-07-03 enumeration; the reference and character-block controls hold identity across the set; the worked patterns instantiate everything upstream as labeled craft; and the failure taxonomy, one-axis loop and ten-item go/no-go come last because they consume all prior nodes to turn drafts into costed, audited, attributable generations.

dominance_rules.rule: The live-surface enumeration dominates memory or marketing for any Higgsfield model claim
dominance_rules.rationale: model ids, params, ratios and constraints were read off the MCP surface on 2026-07-03 and the web catalog names models this account cannot call
dominance_rules.trigger: a model id, parameter, duration, ratio or media role is about to be stated
dominance_rules.action: quote only the enumerated surface; if the surface has not been read for that claim, mark it unknown rather than recalling it

dominance_rules.rule: The texture demand plus directional light dominates any beauty-polish instinct on skin shots
dominance_rules.rationale: the plastic look is the learned default and only explicit imperfections under side light pull the render off it
dominance_rules.trigger: a skin-bearing shot is drafted or edited
dominance_rules.action: keep the pores/fine-lines/uneven-tone clause and a side/back light spec; express polish through grooming, wardrobe and light quality

dominance_rules.rule: The offender-lexicon audit dominates shipping speed
dominance_rules.rationale: one 'flawless' or ring-light clause can undo every other realism investment and the audit is nearly free
dominance_rules.trigger: any prompt is about to be submitted
dominance_rules.action: grep for the offender list and hype stacks before spend; bounce hits back to the lexicon node

dominance_rules.rule: The routed model's schema dominates the studio's default negative block
dominance_rules.rationale: FLUX.2-class models officially take no negatives, so the block is meaningless or harmful there
dominance_rules.trigger: exclusions are being attached to a prompt
dominance_rules.action: read the route's mechanism first; attach the pruned block only where a field exists, else convert to positive phrasing

dominance_rules.rule: The Element lane dominates the Soul lane for any two-persona frame
dominance_rules.rationale: the surface allows exactly one soul_id per generation, so the Soul lane is structurally solo
dominance_rules.trigger: a shot contains more than one recurring identity
dominance_rules.action: route to an Element-compatible model with one element id per persona; never attempt two soul_ids

dominance_rules.rule: A get_cost probe dominates any uncosted batch
dominance_rules.rationale: per-model credit costs are a named unknown and the balance is finite (1,010 credits at enumeration)
dominance_rules.trigger: a generation batch is planned for an unprobed model-resolution cell
dominance_rules.action: probe with get_cost:true first and size the batch to the priced cell

dominance_rules.rationale: same prompt yields different results by design, so one-versus-one comparisons measure noise
dominance_rules.trigger: two prompt variants are being compared
dominance_rules.action: generate at least 2 samples per variant before judging, and treat seed control as unavailable until proven

dominance_rules.rule: The closed likeness lane dominates every craft consideration
dominance_rules.rationale: evoking a specific real person while hiding the face is excluded by contract, not balanced against quality goals
dominance_rules.trigger: a request implies a recognizable real person with the face obscured or swapped
dominance_rules.action: refuse and offer an original persona via the character-block discipline instead

dominance_rules.rule: Carried evidence labels dominate fluent restatement
dominance_rules.rationale: much of the vendor guidance arrived via search excerpts of blocked pages and several craft rules are labeled estimates; stripping labels fabricates certainty
dominance_rules.trigger: a claim from this KB is restated downstream
dominance_rules.action: keep the FACT/excerpt-caveat/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN tag attached exactly as the grounding carries it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the routed model carries the target aspect ratio before writing the prompt
anti_rework_rules.prevents: composing a 21:9 frame for soul_2 and rewriting the whole composition after the ratio check fails

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the offender-lexicon and hype-stack audit before the first generation, not after
anti_rework_rules.prevents: burning batches diagnosing a plastic look that one banned word caused

anti_rework_rules.rule: Choose the identity lane (Soul vs Element) per shot before drafting identity text
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rewriting prompts after discovering Elements do not work on Soul models or that two soul_ids are impossible

anti_rework_rules.rule: Freeze the character and wardrobe blocks as canonical copies before the first shot of a set
anti_rework_rules.prevents: identity drift across a shot set that forces regenerating earlier stills to match a mutated persona

anti_rework_rules.rule: Probe get_cost on every new model-resolution cell before its first batch
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unplanned credit burn that forces cutting later planned iterations

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the scene family's 3-5 color palette before generating any still of the family
anti_rework_rules.prevents: regrading or regenerating a whole family because each still named a different palette

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the establishing frames people-free and front-to-back sharp before any video planning
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reshooting start frames because a populated or shallow-focus frame cannot seed the planned clip

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record every one-axis change in the prompt log at edit time
anti_rework_rules.prevents: losing a winning phrasing and re-running discovery batches to rediscover it
